Checked claim · dissipative-real-storage-sign

Local real stored energy is nonnegative.

Assumptions: Real E0>=0, E1>=0; any real total strain eps and viscous strain v.

theorem storage_nonnegative (E0 E1 eps v : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ E0) (h1 : 0 ≤ E1) :
    0 ≤ storage E0 E1 eps v

Limits: U=E0*eps^2/2+E1*(eps-v)^2/2. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.

Checked claim · dissipative-real-storage-derivative

The real storage time derivative equals E0*eps*epsdot+E1*(eps-v)*(epsdot-vdot).

Assumptions: Fixed real E0,E1; supplied real strain paths eps(t),v(t) with HasDerivAt eps epsdot t and HasDerivAt v vdot t.

theorem storage_hasDerivAt (E0 E1 t epsdot vdot : ℝ) (eps v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (heps : HasDerivAt eps epsdot t) (hv : HasDerivAt v vdot t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => storage E0 E1 (eps s) (v s))
      (storageRate E0 E1 (eps t) (v t) epsdot vdot) t

Limits: Derivative of U for fixed constitutive coefficients and supplied path derivatives. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.

Checked claim · dissipative-real-power-balance

Real stress power equals storage rate plus dissipation under the Maxwell equation.

Assumptions: Real E0,E1,eps,v,eta,epsdot,vdot; assumed constitutive constraint eta*vdot=E1*(eps-v).

theorem local_power_balance (E0 E1 eps v eta epsdot vdot : ℝ)
    (hMaxwell : eta * vdot = E1 * (eps - v)) :
    stress E0 E1 eps v * epsdot =
      storageRate E0 E1 eps v epsdot vdot + dissipationRate eta vdot

Limits: sigma*epsdot=Udot+Ddot; the constitutive constraint is an explicit assumption. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.

Checked claim · dissipative-real-elastic-recovery

Setting E1=0 recovers sigma=E0*eps and U=E0*eps^2/2.

Assumptions: Real E0,eps,v; the Maxwell spring coefficient E1 is exactly zero.

theorem zero_branch_recovers_elastic (E0 eps v : ℝ) :
    stress E0 0 eps v = E0 * eps ∧ storage E0 0 eps v = E0 / 2 * eps ^ 2

Limits: Zero-branch elastic reference; no whole-bar geometry or numerical equivalence is asserted. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.

Checked claim · dissipative-real-viscous-derivative

The exact held-strain exponential has derivative E1*(eps-v(t))/eta.

Assumptions: Fixed real held strain eps, initial viscous strain v0, E1, eta!=0; any real elapsed time t.

theorem viscous_strain_hasDerivAt (eps v0 E1 eta t : ℝ) (heta : eta ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => viscousStrain eps v0 E1 eta s)
      (E1 * (eps - viscousStrain eps v0 E1 eta t) / eta) t

Limits: v(t)=eps+(v0-eps)*exp(-E1*t/eta); constant strain and coefficients only. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.

Checked claim · dissipative-real-viscous-bounds

Forward held-strain viscous strain stays between v0 and eps.

Assumptions: Real held strain eps and initial v0; E1>=0, eta>0 and elapsed time t>=0.

theorem viscous_strain_bounded (eps v0 E1 eta t : ℝ)
    (hE : 0 ≤ E1) (heta : 0 < eta) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    min v0 eps ≤ viscousStrain eps v0 E1 eta t ∧
      viscousStrain eps v0 E1 eta t ≤ max v0 eps

Limits: min(v0,eps)<=v(t)<=max(v0,eps); no general changing-load trajectory is certified. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.

theorem viscous_strain_monotone (eps v0 E1 eta : ℝ)

    Monotone (fun t => viscousStrain eps v0 E1 eta t)

Checked claim · dissipative-real-held-stress-bounds

Forward held-strain stress lies between E0*eps and its initial value when v0<=eps.

Assumptions: Real E0,eps,v0; E1>=0, eta>0, t>=0 and v0<=eps; sigma(t)=E0*eps+E1*(eps-v(t)).

theorem held_stress_bounded (E0 E1 eps v0 eta t : ℝ)
    (hE : 0 ≤ E1) (heta : 0 < eta) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hstart : v0 ≤ eps) :
    E0 * eps ≤ stress E0 E1 eps (viscousStrain eps v0 E1 eta t) ∧
      stress E0 E1 eps (viscousStrain eps v0 E1 eta t) ≤ stress E0 E1 eps v0

Limits: Relative bounds require the stated initial ordering; no assertion of positive stress for arbitrary real strain. Real local constitutive law only; no numerical or JavaScript refinement, axial-bar or quadrature solve, discrete energy-ledger, calibration or biological validation.
